title: AI training reuse, after the Care Passport checklist is completed
note: Simulated scenario. The s2 research handoff re-checked after the patient opts in to research use and the hospital and research partner provide the items SovereignGuard asked for. Processing stays inside the UAE.
patient_request: I have agreed that my de-identified records can be used to train an AI model for research, as long as they stay in the UAE.

consents.form: Separate written opt-in consent signed by the patient for use of de-identified records to train an AI model for research, revocable at any time

steps.title: Hospital shares de-identified record with an AI research partner (inside the UAE)
evidence_provided: Patient's separate written opt-in consent for AI training research, revocable (consent c2)
Research ethics committee approval for the project
De-identification: direct identifiers removed so the data does not identify the patient and cannot practically be used to determine identity
Data-sharing agreement stating the legal basis, consent handling, confidentiality, and health-research-only use
Data stored and processed only inside the UAE
steps.question: May a healthcare facility share de-identified patient health data with a research partner to train an AI model, given the evidence provided, and is anything still missing?
